text:
Type: white sheer tab top curtains, pair
Use: filtering daylight, adding softness to windows; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, coastal, farmhouse
Materials: lightweight sheer voile with a fine textured weave, fabric tab loops
Colors: white, soft translucent white
Shape: two long panels hanging from fabric tabs on a rod, gentle loose folds, floor length, light and airy
Feel: airy, soft, bright, romantic
Goes with: white walls, light wood, linen, pale blue or grey tones; Scandinavian, coastal or cottage rooms

product.name: MATILDA
product.description: The sheer curtains let the daylight through but provide privacy so they are perfect to use in a layered window solution.
